intent.note: The delta against the earlier P152.16 patch is exactly the three fixes. R24: tests/_harness.py adds run_script(path, args, cwd, stdin, env, timeout) which returns run_script_in_process's (code, out, err) when planted_sitecustomize(env) is None, else runs subprocess.run([sys.executable, path] + args) with the same env/stdin and returns (returncode, stdout, stderr). lv_call, gs_gate and _cli_here in tests/test_audit_task.py now call _harness.run_script; no other caller changed. lv_call's merged-stream form is reproduced as (err + out) with a comment on the ordering. Case fb5s sets a sitecustomize on PYTHONPATH and asserts the in-process-refused call still answers fb5's refusal (the process route), restoring PYTHONPATH in a finally; ip12 asserts the planted route ran the file (AUDIT_IP_SITE=ran, pid differs) and the unplanted route stayed in this interpreter (pid equal, variable None), plus before == _process_state(). Both directions are therefore asserted. The PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE sentence ('run_script is the caller's way past that refusal: in this interpreter, or as a process when a sitecustomize is planted (ip12)') matches that code. R25: the added comment says only the three sys.std* objects are swapped and a child started without its own pipes writes to the suite's descriptors and is missing from the returned bytes - accurate. R26: the guide signature now reads run_script_in_process(path, args, cwd, stdin, env, before_main) with a before_main clause. Nothing else is in the delta; no f-strings, annotations, walrus or P/F/BUG ids in the added lines (grep over the added lines was empty). The claim matches the diff. I ran `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/_harness.py tests/test_audit_task.py` once: it printed '2/2 files ok, 1310 cases' (the two added cases fb5s and ip12 over the 1308 the earlier review saw); the exit code was lost in my pipe, so the pass rests on that printed line.
